timeline.summary: Advent Hotels shareholders approved the disinvestment of Bamboo Hotel And Global Centre (Delhi) and the assignment of its loans to Valor Estate Limited.
Advent Hotels reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹114.72 Cr and a net profit of ₹6.80 Cr, following the completion of its hospitality business demerger.
Advent Hotels submitted revised FY26 financial results with the statutory audit declaration and dissolved its voluntary Risk Management Committee.
Advent Hotels submitted a revised outcome of its board meeting with the statutory audit declaration and dissolved its voluntary Risk Management Committee.
Advent Hotels approved the acquisition of the remaining 25% stake in BD&P Hotels for ₹40 Cr to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.
